component.name: Linux Application Remover
component.summary: Uninstall or change a program, Programs and Features style

description.p: Linux Application Remover shows the applications installed on your computer in a compact, sortable table, much like Programs and Features on Windows, and lets you uninstall them.

It detects software installed through APT, DNF, Pacman, Zypper, Flatpak and Snap, hides libraries and other system packages by default, previews exactly what a removal will change, and asks for administrator rights only when the package manager needs them.
